g.text: Inward loading persists across the sampled inputs

g.text: Spray-only controls · one input varied at a time · screening grid 24 × 32 × 32

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #657381

g.text: All values use the computed 10–12 s load and the same strip equation: sheet 0.20 kg/m²; hem 0.05 kg/m.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #657381

g.text: This is a plausible-input study, without experimental fitting. Individual parameter cases have not each been mesh-refined.
